tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page and slide background. Default ground for `ink`, `ink-muted` and `link`.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised ground: cards, inputs, dialogs, slide content panels. Same text colours as `surface-100`.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken ground: code blocks, hover rows, disabled fields. Same text colours as `surface-100`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-300`, `teal`, `pink` and the tints. Also the border colour of controls, cards and slide panes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (captions, helper text, placeholders) on `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-300`. Never on a coloured fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers. Carries no meaning on its own, so it is exempt from 3:1.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, radios and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200` in every theme.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Lead colour: primary button fill, checked states, the main headline frame, the front pane of the logo. Always carries `on-plum` text.

tokens.name: on-plum
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `plum`.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Second voice: frame fill, section slides, selected-tab bar, the back pane of the logo. Always carries `on-teal` text; never used as text on paper.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `teal`.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Hot accent for emphasis frames and one section slide per deck. Carries `on-pink` text; never used for errors (see `danger`) and never as text on paper.

tokens.name: on-pink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `pink`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and link-like controls on `surface-100`, `surface-200`. Always also underlined.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour, drawn 2px off the control so it lands on the surface. At least 3:1 on `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-300`.

tokens.name: plum-tint
tokens.usage: Soft plum ground for selected tabs and highlights. Text: `ink`.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Soft teal ground for info callouts. Text: `ink`.

tokens.name: pink-tint
tokens.usage: Soft pink ground for warm notes. Text: `ink`.

tokens.name: frame-ink
tokens.usage: Ink-toned Pane frame fill; pair with `on-frame-ink`. Inverts in the dark theme.

tokens.name: on-frame-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `frame-ink`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on `success-bg`, `surface-100`, `surface-200`. Blue rather than green so it never relies on a red/green difference; always paired with a check icon and the word.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for success messages. Text: `success` or `ink`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on `warning-bg`, `surface-100`, `surface-200`. Always paired with a triangle icon and the word.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for warning messages. Text: `warning` or `ink`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, icons and error borders on `danger-bg`, `surface-100`, `surface-200`. Always paired with a cross icon and the word; a warm red, distinct from `pink` in hue and lightness.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for error messages. Text: `danger` or `ink`.

families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: slide-display
styles.usage: Title slide name only. 72pt in PowerPoint (16:9, 13.33in), 144pt in a 1920x1080 Keynote.

styles.name: slide-number
styles.usage: One big figure per slide. Pair with a slide-caption.

styles.name: slide-caption
styles.usage: Figure captions, source lines, footers. 14pt PowerPoint: the smallest size allowed on a slide.

styles.name: slide-lead
styles.usage: Opening statement under a headline. 22pt PowerPoint.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.usage: Body copy and list items. 18pt PowerPoint: the smallest body size.

styles.name: slide-quote
styles.usage: Pull quotes, set in italic via the `quote` slide.

styles.name: slide-code
styles.usage: Code and values on slides. 16pt PowerPoint.

styles.name: ui-small
styles.usage: Helper text, tags. Smallest interface size.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Paragraphs and descriptions. 18px so serif text stays comfortable.

styles.name: ui-code
styles.usage: Inline code, code blocks, tokens in documentation.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between label and field, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, field gaps. Default step.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between related groups; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections in an interface.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large gaps; frame stagger.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Slide gutters between columns.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Slide inner margin top/bottom.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Slide outer margin left/right (1920x1080 canvas).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Pane frames, slides, images: square, like a window pane.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, code blocks, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Radios, switches, dots. Not for buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-pane-sm
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow: raised cards and buttons on hover. Echoes the stacked pane in the logo.

tokens.name: shadow-pane-md
tokens.usage: Screenshots and figures on slides; dialogs.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any pressable control (WCAG 2.5.5).

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Control and frame borders.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring thickness.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between control and focus ring.

tokens.name: slide-width
tokens.usage: Slide canvas width. PowerPoint 16:9 equals 960pt, so 1px = 0.5pt.

tokens.name: slide-height
tokens.usage: Slide canvas height.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for body text in interfaces.
